meta.title: S & V · Mexico
meta.blurb: A winter-holiday dossier for two. S lands MEX around midnight on 24 Dec (possibly just after midnight on the 25th). V is already on the trip. Order is CDMX (Roma 24–28 Dec, 4 nights) → Puebla (28–31 Dec, 3 nights) → Oaxaca (31 Dec–5 Jan) → CDMX (5–8 Jan); home on 8 Jan.

altitudes.note: Sleeping altitude. Landing here is unavoidable.
Only ~100 m lower — not a descent that helps.
The easier sleep. Sooner is kinder after MEX.

homeLeg.summary: MEX 12:22 → DFW 15:15, DFW 17:20 → HEL 11:10 +1. Travel day, no sightseeing. Leave Polanco early; 3 h before international departure. Taxi 30–60 min.

cdmx: Sun Stone, Sala Mexica — Anthropology (highlights, not the whole museum)
Casa Azul timed ticket (no door sales) + Anahuacalli the same ticket
Coyoacán on foot — plazas, not a museum stack on 25 Dec
Tacos in Roma–Condesa on a normal evening, not Christmas or Frida day
oaxaca: Monte Albán at opening with a private driver, then the pool
Levadura de Olla — Saturday 2 Jan 19:00 (closed Sun & Mon)
South valley handicrafts: Coyotepec → Jalieza → Tilcajete (not five villages)
East valley mezcal: Tule → Mitla → two palenques, not a warehouse tour
NYE in Centro on foot after a rooftop dinner
Criollo last night if it is a Monday–Saturday
puebla: Cholula ceremonial area + site museum (tunnels closed)
Remedios church stairs for the volcano view
Puebla Centro: Zócalo, Palafoxiana, Rosario if short — skip Amparo on a combo day

pueblaSlots.title: Superseded
pueblaSlots.why: Day-trip ranking retired. Baseline A is an overnight Puebla stay 28–31 Dec (3 nights; was 4 so NYE stays in Oaxaca). Not shown on the Trip tab.

hotels.name: Hilton Mexico City Airport
hotels.note: Inside T1, Gate 8, 3rd level. 24 h. Shuttle hotel → T2. Match S’s terminal.

hotels.name: Courtyard by Marriott Mexico City Airport
hotels.note: T1 pedestrian skybridge, 24 h, free shuttle to T2.

hotels.name: Camino Real Aeropuerto Mexico
hotels.note: Covered bridge to T1 Gate B, 24 h T2 shuttle.

hotels.name: NH Collection Mexico City Airport T2
hotels.note: Inside T2, elevator. Best if S lands T2.

hotels.name: Las Alcobas
hotels.note: Masaryk 390, steps to Parque Lincoln. Adults 13+.

hotels.name: InterContinental Presidente
hotels.note: Campos Elíseos 218 — Au Pied de Cochon on site.

hotels.name: Otro Oaxaca
hotels.note: Macedonio Alcalá 505, facing Santo Domingo. Rooftop pool + spa. Best special pick.

hotels.name: Quinta Real Oaxaca
hotels.note: 5 de Mayo 300. Convent, pool. Skip a locked NYE gala.

hotels.name: Los Pilares
hotels.note: Curtidurías 721-A, Jalatlaco, plunge pool. 15–20 min walk to Santo Domingo.

restaurants.name: Au Pied de Cochon
restaurants.note: Polanco, Presidente InterContinental, Campos Elíseos 218. Officially 24 h / 365 — the only kitchen that promises 25 Dec. OpenTable, typically over MXN 500.

restaurants.name: Los Danzantes Coyoacán
restaurants.note: Parque Centenario 12. Best geography after a Coyoacán afternoon. Holiday hours unknown — confirm that week.

restaurants.name: Corazón de Maguey
restaurants.note: Plaza Jardín Centenario 9A. Confirm 25 Dec.

restaurants.name: Comedor Jacinta
restaurants.note: Virgilio 40. Bib Gourmand, walk from Lincoln. Polanco dinner after the 5 Jan return.

restaurants.name: Chapulín
restaurants.note: Campos Elíseos 218.

restaurants.name: Quintonil
restaurants.note: Newton 55. Tasting MXN 6090 · €309, Sunday closed, website reservations only. Thu 7 Jan is a service day.

restaurants.name: El Cardenal Palma
restaurants.note: Palma 23. Lunch only 08:00–18:30. Centro lunch on 6 Jan (Templo / Bellas Artes day).

restaurants.name: Azul Histórico
restaurants.note: Isabel la Católica 30. 13:00–23:00 daily, Resy.

restaurants.name: Sud 777
restaurants.note: Jardines del Pedregal — better geography after Coyoacán / Anahuacalli.

restaurants.name: Orinoco
restaurants.note: Tacos. After Anthropology on 26 Dec, or the extra Roma/Condesa day on 27 Dec. Skip 25 Dec and 7 Jan.

restaurants.name: El Califa
restaurants.note: Tacos Roma–Condesa. Same window as Orinoco.

restaurants.name: Café El Jarocho
restaurants.note: Walk-up coffee, Coyoacán.

restaurants.name: Asador Bacanora
restaurants.note: Jalatlaco, 5 de Mayo 614. 15–20 min walk from Centro. Useful when arrival is not NYE. Baseline 31 Dec is Casa Oaxaca rooftop, not Bacanora.

restaurants.name: Tierra del Sol
restaurants.note: Watch-list. Useful 1 Jan if markets are thin.

restaurants.name: Los Danzantes Oaxaca
restaurants.note: Andador. NYE backup. Confirm that week.

restaurants.name: Levadura de Olla
restaurants.note: Closed Sun & Mon — cannot be 27 Dec or 4 Jan. Book Sat 2 Jan 19:00 now (moved off Tue 29 Dec; that night is Puebla). No under-12.

restaurants.name: Alfonsina
restaurants.note: San Juan Bautista La Raya, not Centro. Lunch on a non-Sunday south-valley day. Sunday 3 Jan is a worse fit.

restaurants.name: Origen
restaurants.note: Dinner alternative to Alfonsina when the south-valley day is Sunday. NYE watch-list.

restaurants.name: Casa Oaxaca rooftop
restaurants.note: Constitución 104-A, 2 min to the plaza. NYE proposal ~19:00–20:00 then walk Santo Domingo / Zócalo. Mon–Sat 13:00–23:00, Sun 13:00–21:00.

restaurants.name: Criollo
restaurants.note: Dinner Mon–Sat 18:00–21:00. Last night Mon 4 Jan at 18:00. OpenTable. Levadura is closed that Monday.

restaurants.name: Pitiona
restaurants.note: NYE watch-list. Saturday 2 Jan is Levadura, not a leftover.

restaurants.name: In Situ
restaurants.note: Mezcal bar. One directory lists Sunday close; 1 Jan is Friday — ask 31 Dec.

restaurants.name: Terranova Zócalo
restaurants.note: Claims 365 days, 08:00–midnight. 1 Jan recovery breakfast if the hotel is quiet.

tours.name: Monte Albán private driver at 08:00
tours.note: Daily 08:00–17:00, last access 16:00, MXN 210 · €11. ~2–3 h on site, 8 km west. Sun and stairs, not extra altitude vs CDMX.

tours.name: South valley handicrafts
tours.note: Coyotepec (barro negro) → Jalieza (backstrap) → lunch → Tilcajete (alebrijes; Jacobo y María Ángeles). Not five villages. Atzompa pairs with Monte Albán instead.

tours.name: East valley mezcal
tours.note: Tule → optional Teotitlán → Mitla (INAH daily 08:00–17:00 last 16:30, MXN 210 · €11) → two palenques toward Matatlán. Guide Juan Montes-Lara a usual pick. Buy bottles at the palenque you like.

tours.name: Real Minero (south, not with Mitla)
tours.note: Santa Catarina Minas. 3 h reserved visit Mon–Fri 10:00 & 15:00, Sat 10:00 with 48 h notice, closed Sun, MXN 750 · €38, max 25. Do not combine with Mitla.

tours.name: Hierve el Agua
tours.note: ~1.5–1 h 45 drive. Hours conflict 07:00–18:00 vs 09:00–17:00. Upper pools, can shut with little warning. Private and early or skip.

tours.name: Casa Crespo cooking class
tours.note: Public Tue–Sun 10:00 MXN 1350 · €68 (Sunday published). Private 4 h MXN 6650 · €337 for 1–2. Fits Sun 3 Jan.

tours.name: Casa Azul timed ticket
tours.note: Tickets only at boletos.museofridakahlo.org.mx — no door sales. Closed 25 Dec and 1 Jan 2027. Reduced 24 and 31 Dec. Ticket includes courtesy Anahuacalli (15–20 min drive, not walkable).

tours.name: Anahuacalli
tours.note: Tue–Sun 11:00–17:30. Calle Museo 150, San Pablo Tepetlapa. Same ticket as Casa Azul.

tours.name: Museo Nacional de Antropología
tours.note: Tue–Sun 09:00–18:00, closed Mon. MXN 210 · €11. Baseline A is Saturday 26 Dec (INAH open). 6 Jan is Centro / Templo / Bellas Artes instead. Do not stack Castillo + Templo.

tours.name: Castillo de Chapultepec highlights
tours.note: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00. MXN 210 · €11. Paved ramp 10–20 min, no elevator. Highlights only if paired with Anthropology.

tours.name: Templo Mayor
tours.note: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00. MXN 210 · €11 INAH. 6 Jan 2027 (Día de Reyes) expected open. 2024–25 closed 25 Dec and 1 Jan only.

tours.name: Palacio de Bellas Artes museum
tours.note: Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:30. MXN 95 · €5 same-day taquilla only. Sun free. Concert hall is separate.

tours.name: Museo Soumaya Plaza Carso
tours.note: Every day 10:30–18:30, free. Light add-on 5 Jan (Tuesday).

tours.name: Cholula archaeological zone
tours.note: Wed–Sun 09:00–17:00. Closed Mon AND Tue. Foreigner MXN 210 · €11. Tunnels closed until further notice (still as of 29 Jun 2026). Church on top is separate, 07:00–19:00.

playgroundBlocks.label: CDMX Christmas
playgroundBlocks.hint: 25 Dec Coyoacán. Museums shut. Nochebuena was the 24th.

playgroundBlocks.label: CDMX museums
playgroundBlocks.hint: In baseline A, Anthropology is 26 Dec (Chapultepec); Centro / Templo / Bellas Artes is 6 Jan. Playground still uses two museum days after Oaxaca.

playgroundBlocks.label: Oaxaca
playgroundBlocks.hint: Absorbs leftover days. NYE belongs here. Buses: CDMX→Puebla 28 Dec, Puebla→Oaxaca 31 Dec, Oaxaca→TAPO 5 Jan; details on the tab.

playgroundBlocks.label: Puebla / Cholula
playgroundBlocks.hint: Three overnight days in Puebla/Cholula (was 4 — shrink so NYE stays in Oaxaca). Cholula closed Mon & Tue — those become Centro days. Full Cholula day is Wednesday 30.

playgroundBlocks.label: Frida + Coyoacán
playgroundBlocks.hint: Timed tickets. Closed 25 Dec and 1 Jan. Includes Anahuacalli.

scenarioA.name: Baseline
scenarioA.lede: Roma Norte 24–28 Dec (4 nights; decided), then Puebla 28–31 Dec (3 nights; was 4 so NYE stays in Oaxaca), Oaxaca 31 Dec–5 Jan for the valley and NYE, back to CDMX 5–8 Jan (3 nights). Buses, no internal flights: CDMX → Puebla 28 Dec, Puebla → Oaxaca 31 Dec morning, Oaxaca → TAPO 5 Jan. Overnight vs day still open on 5 Jan.

scenarioB.name: Altitude reverse
scenarioB.lede: Land, then either sleep the airport hotel or go straight to Roma Norte if self-check-in is ready. Go to Oaxaca as soon as that is humane. Christmas and NYE at 1,542 m. CDMX museums and Frida after the return. Locked to bus; overnight vs day still open on the CDMX–Oaxaca tab.
